title: Database Management Systems (DBMS)
content: Comprehensive notes covering relational algebra, SQL, normalization (1NF to BCNF), transaction management, and concurrency control. Includes PYQs from 2022 and 2023.

title: Operating Systems - Core Concepts
content: Detailed guide on processes, threads, CPU scheduling algorithms, deadlocks, and memory management (paging and segmentation).

title: Data Structures and Algorithms
content: Array, Linked List, Stack, Queue, Trees (Binary, AVL, Red-Black), Graphs (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Prim, Kruskal), and Hashing.

title: Computer Networks: A Top-Down Approach
content: Kurose & Ross textbook. Covers application layer (HTTP, DNS), transport layer (TCP/UDP), network layer (IP, routing), and link layer.

title: Database System Concepts (Silberschatz)
content: Classic textbook by Abraham Silberschatz, Henry F. Korth, and S. Sudarshan. Excellent reference for deep theoretical DBMS concepts.

title: Modern Operating Systems (Tanenbaum)
content: Andrew S. Tanenbaum's book providing a comprehensive look at OS architecture, interprocess communication, and file systems.

title: Software Engineering Notes
content: SDLC models (Waterfall, Agile, Scrum), requirements engineering, software design patterns, and testing methodologies (Unit, Integration, System).

title: Object-Oriented Programming (Java) PYQs
content: Past Year Questions covering encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, exception handling, and multithreading in Java.

title: Introduction to Algorithms (Cormen)
content: CLRS textbook. The standard reference for rigorous algorithm analysis, dynamic programming, and greedy algorithms.

title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
content: Stuart Russell and Peter Norvig's text on intelligent agents, search algorithms (A*), machine learning foundations, and natural language processing.
